lines: Like a defensive reflex, large sighs kept leaking out, over and over, as if there were an infinite supply.
Damn it... I'm getting involved in a hassle again...
I received a message from Teacher Asagi. I had come to the town of Gosha, but my feet felt heavy whether I wanted them to or not.
To drink until you're running around causing a scene... I can't understand that at all.
I don't hate alcohol, but I'm not fond of it enough to drink that much. It was behavior I simply couldn't comprehend.
But... since I was asked to... I have to do something about it...
No matter how much I complain, it won't change anything. I just have to take action before the damage spreads further.
I headed toward the location Teacher Asagi had told me about, looking for the woman who was drinking and causing a ruckus in broad daylight.
As I approached the designated scene, I could feel the tension in the surroundings intensifying through my skin.
Do I really have to go...? I don't see why I need to be the one to go.
Sensing the crisis, my brain began listing reasons why I shouldn't go in order to stop me in my tracks.
But not going would be really bad... I have no idea what Teacher Asagi would say to me...
Homura at the front gate, Teacher Asagi at the back gate...
Going is hell, and going back is hell too...
Dragging my leaden feet, I ended up arriving at the scene after all.
I didn't want to come, but the scene I had arrived at was a picture of chaos.
A flower bed had been overturned and trampled into a mess. A poor, lost bench had been moved far from where it was supposed to be.
A banner had been snapped clean in two, losing all its life. I didn't even need to check; this was the scene Teacher Asagi had designated.
You guys! What do you mean I can't have my sake?! What is that supposed to mean?! Hm?!
H-Homura-san... please, have mercy... Ugh, nngh...!!
What do you mean "please spare me"?! I can drink, can't I?! Ah, drink more! Drink until you puke, and if you puke, drink again! Come on!!

The target this time, Sanada Homura, was a boisterous woman in a kimono, laughing her head off while forcing sake down the throat of a generic-looking man she was holding under her arm like a school bag.
(This is interesting. I might as well watch a little longer...)
I had no idea why she was wearing a kimono or why she was holding an old man under her arm, but this scene was just too funny.
(Watching stuff like this from a safe distance is really fun... It's a different story if you're the one involved, though...)
H-Homura-san... I, I can't... anymore... I'm going to... ah, huuuuu...
Tch, he passed out... Hey, old man, come here!
The newly targeted old man (2) tried desperately to escape, but he was caught without a fight and became Homura's new school bag.
There, drink! Drink it! Drink my sake! Drink it all!
Homura, laughing maniacally as she forced sake into the mouth of the desperately resisting man, was truly a demon incarnate.
The face of old man (2), who had sake forcibly poured into him, turned red and then blue in a matter of moments, but she kept pouring it in without a care.
How's that? Tastes good, right? My sake is the best! Come on, drink! Drink more!!
Old man (2), who had been forced to drink more sake than his stomach could hold, collapsed even faster than old man (1).
No patience? When she snapped at the useless old men, Homura let out a roar like a wild beast while continuing to pour sake into her stomach.
The scene was so blindingly chaotic that I wanted to cover my eyes, and as Homura continued her outrageous behavior, my inner thoughts slipped out of my mouth before I could stop them.
(This is bad... but I was whispering, right? It should be fine...)
It should have been a voice at the threshold of being audible, yet Homura's eyes snapped sharply and locked onto my figure.
Who the hell is talking back to me?!
She let out a low voice that seemed to echo from the bottom of hell, slowly and steadily closing the distance between us, step by step.
This was my only chance to run, but my legs were paralyzed by the sheer killing intent radiating from her, and I let that chance slip away.
I wondered who the heck you were and came to check, and it turns out you're Fuma!!
The moment she confirmed my face, the killing intent she had been radiating vanished, and in its place, she started grinning mischievously.
But no matter who you are... I can't forgive this...? Hm...?
N-no... I do think I was wrong... but it hurts, it really hurts!!
As Homura wrapped her arm around my neck, I was completely stripped of my freedom and, just like the old man, became a victim of Homura's second bag.
I was drinking so nicely, don't ruin it for me. Hm~? Are you even listening, Fuma?
I didn't mean to ruin it... but if I did, I apologize, I'm sorry...
(This person is hopeless... her brain is fried from the alcohol...)
While being held by Homura, who had started chugging the sake she had just forced on the old man, I let out a sigh mixed with resignation and exasperation.
Of course, I made sure Homura didn't notice...
I know you're sighing, so don't think I didn't notice.
Of course you are. Who do you think I am? Even when I'm drunk, my mind is clear as day.
I don't understand what you mean.
Gahahaha! What a coincidence, I was thinking the same thing!
Judging by her boisterous laughter, it seemed Homura was in a considerably better mood than I had initially imagined.
I have a question for the sober part of your mind, Homura. Why are you wearing that outfit?
I asked about something that had been on my mind ever since I saw Homura running around in a frenzy, hoping to verify if her good mood was genuine.
In fact, I had been curious about why she was wearing a kimono, so if this clarified that too, it would be a win-win.
Ah, this? I got hot from the alcohol, so I took my clothes off.
Watching Homura speak with a rapturous expression, as if recounting a beautiful memory from the past, I realized with certainty that this good mood was real.
Well, that's to be expected. I could figure that out without even thinking about it.
A man saw my naked body and started hitting on me with a lecherous face. A pervert like you, Fuuma.
I am not a pervert. No matter what anyone says, I am a gentleman. Please don't lump me in with that lecherous old man.
I hear that liars tend to talk fast.
Please don't treat me like that kind of person.
Every time she teased me and burst into hearty laughter, Homura's ample breasts would bump against my face, bouncing softly and feeling incredibly nice (sincere).
So, what were we talking about again?
I was asking what happened to that outfit.
Ah, this one, well... I got hot from the alcohol and...
So you took your clothes off, got cold, ended up naked, and some weird old man started hitting on you. Go on, Homura.
It is common sense in this world for drunks to repeat the same thing over and over, so let me do the same.
Please. I am very curious about what happened after that, so tell me.
The story was getting ridiculously long, so I cut her off and forced her to continue.
So basically, I snatched that old man's clothes. That is why I am wearing this outfit, gahahaha!
The fact that she stretched a story that should have ended in seconds into a long, rambling mess was just another trait of a drunk, so I had stopped caring about it.
The old man who had his clothes stolen...
Hah? He's probably lying around somewhere. I don't know.
While feeling sympathy for the pitiful pervert who had been stripped, I didn't search the pile of corpses for the owner of the clothes because I didn't want to see a man's naked body.
I understand the circumstances of those clothes now... Homura, let's head back before things get serious, okay?
I tried to coax her into leaving before the mountain of corpses Homura had piled up woke up, but...
I'm not done getting drunk yet!!!!
Homura tightened her grip on my neck, and a strange sound that was neither voice nor breath leaked from my mouth, unable to pass through my vocal cords.
Homura, holding me under her arm where I could only make pathetic sounds, took a bold gulp of sake.
Over Homura's ample chest, I could hear the sound of sake being poured into her body and the gurgling of her throat.
After downing a large amount of sake in one go, Homura roared with a bottle in hand, her cheeks flushed red.
She was in the best of moods.
While I was being held under her arm, a heavy, swollen weight was pushed firmly against my face.
(Honestly, it doesn't feel bad, but... if I stay like this, I might get strangled to death...)
Between the soft feel of the breasts, the awkwardness, and the tightening grip, I was hesitating over what to do next.
Ugh, mph, mm, mmmm!! Puhaaaaa! Let's go!!
(If I keep this up... I'm going to get killed...!!)
Facing death, I tried to escape the agony, but I was drawn back by the feel of the breasts. I twisted left and right again and again, searching for a way out.
Hey, Fuuma! If you keep thrashing around, you're going to spill the sake!
My body, which had been given even more force than I could even remember holding back, was completely stripped of its freedom by Sanada Homura.
Because they were squeezed so tightly, Homura's chest was pressed into my face, making me feel both agony and pleasure.
(If I stay like this... I'm going to lose it... This situation... I have to do something...)
To somehow change the subject, I put my only freely moving organ, my brain, into full operation, searching for a topic that would improve the situation.
H-Homura... why do you drink so much sake...?
(Kuaaaaaah!!! What am I doing! Asking a question like that is the same as pouring oil on the fire!)
As I regretted what had slipped out of my mouth, Homura let out a boisterous shout.
Of course it's because it's delicious, isn't it! I'm not stupid enough to go out of my way to drink something that isn't tasty!!
Or is there something? Are you trying to say that I'm a stupid woman who drinks a lot of bad stuff?
I-I didn't mean it like that...
Perhaps due to the power of the alcohol, Homura was speaking far more than usual.
I know that much. I was just teasing you a bit, nnn, nnn! Puhaa!!
The Fire Style group has a lot of members and units, so while we get along well, the relationships are quite complex...
In stark contrast to her previous boisterousness, Homura began to speak quietly, holding a bottle of sake in her hand.
Because there are so many people, there is a lot of envy and jealousy... and we often have to be on guard against others' wary eyes.
That sounds like quite a hassle...
Aah, yes, it's a total pain in the ass! That's why I need sake to blow all that troublesome stuff away! Gahahaha!
As if to shatter the atmosphere that had been starting to settle, Homura laughed even more boisterously than before.
(I never imagined Homura would be thinking about that... I'm sorry, but I... I thought she was the type who didn't care about things like that...)
Feeling as though I had glimpsed a new side of the woman known as Sanada Homura, I couldn't help but be impressed.
Ah, right... I forgot to mention the most important reason.
Holding my breath, ready to absorb whatever outrageous words might come out, I waited for Homura's next sentence.
When you're drunk, you can get away with a lot of stuff!
Homura was... even more Homura than I had imagined...
What's with that dumbfounded look! If you have time to gawp, you might as well come with me to one more place, you bastard!
Homura laughed heartily while tightening her grip on my neck again.
I twisted my body, desperately trying to stop her, but
Shut up! I'll throw you! I said I'm going to one more place, so we're going!
Homura forcibly dragged my resisting body, attempting to abduct... take me to the next tavern.
Immediately after, Homura let out a small groan and stopped moving.
(I have a bad feeling... This feeling is... probably going to come true...!!!)
Ugh... I... I can't... take it anymore...
As if she couldn't hear my voice, Homura let out a pained sound, and from her mouth, finally...
Ugh... it's disgusting... my head hurts... ugh...
I stared with dead eyes as I cleaned up what Homura vomited, cursing Asagi-sensei for making me do this.
You can drink, but don't let the drink get you... I should have listened to the old saying...
